skills.name: Driving Basics
skills.description: Steering, accelerating and braking so your car goes exactly where you point it.
skills.whyItMatters: Every other skill depends on placing your car where you want it.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Boost Basics, Jumping and Flips, Camera Basics, Powerslide Basics and 3 more.
instructions: Hold [Gas] to accelerate and steer with the Left Stick.
Tap [Brake] to slow down or reverse, and ease off [Gas] before a turn.
Use small, smooth stick movements instead of pushing the stick all the way over.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive a full lap around the field without touching a wall.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Drive to each corner boost pad in turn and stop on it using [Brake].

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Repeat the lap 3 times in a row without a single wall touch.

masteryRequirements.text: Drive to any spot you pick without overshooting it.
Finish a lap of the field with no wall touches.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Get from your goal to the ball without spinning out or stopping.

commonMistakes: Braking too late for a turn.
skills.easierDrill: Drive slowly around the center circle, then speed up a little each lap.

skills.name: Boost Basics
skills.description: Using [Boost] to go faster and knowing where boost pads are.
skills.whyItMatters: Boost is your fuel. Knowing how to get and spend it matters in every match.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Basic Aerials, Boost Management I, Kickoff Fundamentals.
instructions: Hold [Boost] together with [Gas] to reach top speed.
Drive over pads to refill: small pads give a little, big corner pads fill you almost fully.
Release [Boost] when you are already at top speed, because holding it then wastes fuel.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drain your boost, then refill it using only the pads on your half.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Collect all six big pads in a loop and note how long each takes to refill.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Refill from empty to full 3 times without slowing down.

masteryRequirements.text: Point out all six big boost pads from memory.
Refill from empty to full without stopping your car.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Play a match where you are never at 0 boost for more than a few seconds.

commonMistakes: Ignoring small pads that lie on your path.
skills.easierDrill: Only collect the big corner pads until you know where they are.

skills.name: Jumping and Flips
skills.description: Jumping, jumping a second time, and flipping in a direction to hit the ball or gain speed.
skills.whyItMatters: Flips give you speed and power, and are the base for aerials and kickoffs.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Landing on Your Wheels, Basic Aerials, Basic Wall Hits, Basic 50/50s and 2 more.
instructions: Press [Jump] once to hop. Hold it a little longer to jump higher.
Press [Jump] again with the Left Stick pushed forward to flip forward, or with no direction for a plain double jump.
Flip toward the ball as you reach it to add power to your hit.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, do 10 jumps, then 10 double jumps with no direction.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Drive at speed and front-flip 10 times, landing on your wheels each time.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Front, side and back flip 5 times each without landing on your roof.

masteryRequirements.text: Do a front flip on demand at driving speed.
Flip in all four directions and land on your wheels 8 times out of 10.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Use a flip to reach a ball you would have missed while driving.

commonMistakes: Flipping too early, before the ball is close.
Landing on the roof after a flip.
skills.easierDrill: Practice only jumps and plain double jumps until they feel automatic.

skills.name: Camera Basics
skills.description: Using ball cam and choosing camera settings so you can always see the play.
skills.whyItMatters: You cannot react to what you cannot see. Good camera habits improve every read.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Basic Positioning, Consistent Shooting.
instructions: Press [Ball Cam] to switch between looking at the ball and looking where you drive.
Use ball cam when going toward the ball, and free camera when you need to see boost pads or the field ahead.
Try a wider field of view in Settings so more of the field is visible.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive around and toggle ball cam on and off 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Chase a rolling ball with ball cam on, then find a boost pad with it off.

masteryRequirements.text: Toggle ball cam on and off without looking at your hands.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Play one match where you switch camera deliberately when going for boost.

commonMistakes: Leaving ball cam on while trying to line up a boost pad.
skills.easierDrill: Keep ball cam on and only practice turning it off when you want to steer.

skills.name: Powerslide Basics
skills.description: Holding [Powerslide] to turn tightly without losing much speed.
skills.whyItMatters: Powerslide is how you turn quickly, which is a big part of getting to the ball first.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Powerslide Turnarounds, Ball Control Basics.
instructions: Steer into a turn and hold [Powerslide] while turning.
Release [Powerslide] as the car points where you want to go.
Tap it rather than holding it for the whole turn to keep your speed.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive in a circle holding [Powerslide] and steering into it.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do 90 degree turns at a corner using [Powerslide], then release and accelerate.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Turn around at the center circle 10 times without slowing to a stop.

masteryRequirements.text: Make a 90 degree turn without stopping or hitting the wall.
Turn to face any direction and drive straight out of it.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Use a powerslide turn at least once to get back toward your goal.

skills.easierDrill: Practice a slow wide turn with a short [Powerslide] tap at the start.

skills.name: Ball Contact
skills.description: Hitting the ball on purpose, with the part of your car and the timing that sends it where you want.
skills.whyItMatters: Before you can shoot or save, you have to touch the ball where you intend to.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Basic Shooting, Basic Saves, Powerful Clears, Basic Challenges and 1 more.
instructions: Line up so the ball is in front of your car, then drive through it.
Aim your nose slightly below the ball to send it up, and at the middle to send it straight.
Use ball cam ([Ball Cam]) to keep the ball in view as you approach.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, roll the ball slowly and hit it straight ahead 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Hit a rolling ball toward the far wall from different starting spots.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit the ball into an open goal from midfield 10 times in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Hit the ball where you aimed at least 8 out of 10 times.
Touch a bouncing ball without stopping your car.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Get a clean touch on the ball on most possessions instead of missing it.

commonMistakes: Swinging wildly instead of lining up first.
skills.easierDrill: Hit a stationary ball into the open goal from close range.

skills.name: Basic Shooting
skills.description: Hitting the ball toward the net so it has a real chance to score.
skills.whyItMatters: Goals win matches. Even simple, on-target shots create chances.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Consistent Shooting.
instructions: Line up the ball with the goal and drive toward it.
Aim at a corner rather than the middle of the net.
Add a flip ([Jump] with the stick forward) as you hit for more power.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, place yourself near the goal and hit 10 shots at an open net.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Shoot a rolling ball from midfield at the far corner.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Score 5 shots in a row from different angles.

masteryRequirements.text: Hit the ball on target 8 out of 10 times from mid-range.
Aim shots at either corner on request.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Take at least three shots in a match that would have scored if not saved.

commonMistakes: Taking a shot from too far out with no aim.
skills.easierDrill: Shoot from right in front of the goal until the shot feels automatic.

skills.name: Basic Saves
skills.description: Stopping the ball from reaching your net by getting in its path.
skills.whyItMatters: Saves keep you in the match. Even a simple block is worth a goal.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Powerful Clears, Defensive Positioning.
instructions: Face the ball and stay between it and your goal.
Drive toward the ball rather than waiting for it to hit you.
Jump or flip into the ball if it is in the air to redirect it away from the goal.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, have the ball rolled toward your goal and block it 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Start in the goal, react to a shot from the side, and save it.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Make 5 saves in a row from shots at varying corners.

masteryRequirements.text: Save a shot to each corner from a ball rolling toward the goal.
Get to a high shot and push it away from the net.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Make at least two saves in a match without giving up the follow-up shot.

commonMistakes: Sitting still on the goal line.
skills.easierDrill: Practice blocking slow shots from the center only.

statChecks.label: Average at least 1 save per match over 3 matches

skills.name: Basic Positioning
skills.description: Standing between the ball and your own goal, not on top of the ball all the time.
skills.whyItMatters: Good positioning stops goals before they happen and helps you win the next ball.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Basic Challenges, Shadow Defense, Defensive Positioning.
instructions: When the ball is near your goal, get between it and the net.
When the ball is at the other end, stay back toward midfield instead of driving to it.
Use ball cam ([Ball Cam]) to watch the ball while you position.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, move the ball around and keep yourself between it and your goal.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Play a 1v1 against a slow opponent, resetting to your goal after each touch.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Stay between the ball and your goal for a full 3 minute match.

masteryRequirements.text: Reset toward your goal after every attack.
Stay between the ball and your net for one full match.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Notice at least three times you stayed back instead of chasing, and the ball came to you.

commonMistakes: Leaving your own goal wide open.
skills.easierDrill: In Freeplay, simply stand between the ball and your goal while it rolls around.

skills.name: Landing on Your Wheels
skills.description: Turning your car so its wheels touch down first after a jump or flip.
skills.whyItMatters: Landing on your wheels keeps your speed and lets you drive immediately.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Recovering from Upside Down.
instructions: After a jump or flip, tilt the nose down or up with the Left Stick so the car levels out.
Tap [Air Roll Left] or [Air Roll Right] to roll wheels-down if you are sideways or upside down.
Touch down while still moving, so you keep your speed.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, jump and land on your wheels 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Front-flip at speed and land on your wheels while still moving.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Flip in each direction and land on your wheels 8 times out of 10.

masteryRequirements.text: Land on your wheels after a flip 8 out of 10 times.
Keep driving without stopping after landing.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Land on your wheels after every jump in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Practice plain jumps with no flip and land on your wheels first.

skills.name: Consistent Shooting
skills.description: Turning shots into goals more reliably by choosing where to aim and lining up first.
skills.whyItMatters: Consistency turns chances into wins and stops you wasting possession.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Shooting.
instructions: Look at the goalkeeper first, then aim at the far corner or the gap.
Approach in a straight line so your hit goes where you aim.
Hit the ball with the front of your car and flip through it for power.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, take 10 shots at open corners from mid-range.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Take 10 shots on a rolling ball approaching from the left, then from the right.

drills.title: Pressure
drills.text: Play a 1v1 against a bot and take only shots you have lined up.

masteryRequirements.text: Score 7 out of 10 shots from mid-range on an open net.
Aim at either corner when asked.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Take shots in a match that you lined up on purpose, not just hit toward the goal.

commonMistakes: Rushing the shot before lining up.
skills.easierDrill: Practice from point-blank range at each corner.

statChecks.label: Score on at least 30% of your shots over 3 matches

skills.name: Powerful Clears
skills.description: Hitting the ball hard and far away from your goal to end an attack.
skills.whyItMatters: A good clear relieves pressure and buys you time to reposition.
skills.whatItUnlocks: This is a top-level habit: it keeps everything you already know working at game speed.
instructions: Approach the ball with pace and flip into it ([Jump]) for extra power.
Aim toward a side wall or the far corner, away from the middle where the opponent waits.
Follow the ball out so you are not stranded deep in your own end.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, roll the ball toward your goal and clear it across the field 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Clear from behind your own goal to the far wall.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Clear 8 out of 10 balls past midfield.

masteryRequirements.text: Clear a ball past midfield 8 out of 10 times.
Clear to a side instead of the middle.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Clear at least three balls in a match that do not come straight back to your goal.

commonMistakes: Clearing into the middle of the field.
skills.easierDrill: Practice clears from a stationary ball in front of your goal.

skills.name: Basic Aerials
skills.description: Leaving the ground with a jump and boost to hit a ball that is up in the air.
skills.whyItMatters: A lot of the ball is in the air. Aerials let you reach it first.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Defensive Aerials, Fast Aerials, Advanced Wall Play.
instructions: Jump ([Jump]), then hold [Boost] and tilt the nose up by pulling the Left Stick back.
Steer toward the ball in the air with the Left Stick while boosting.
Stop boosting shortly before contact and hit the ball with the front of your car.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, jump and boost straight up 10 times without flipping over.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Hit a ball dropped in front of you in the air 10 times.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit a bouncing ball in the air 5 times in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Hit a stationary high ball 8 out of 10 times.
Land on your wheels after the aerial.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Make one aerial touch in a match without abandoning your position.

commonMistakes: Jumping far too early or too late.
skills.easierDrill: Practice jumping and boosting up to a ball resting on the ground near a wall.

skills.name: Basic Wall Hits
skills.description: Driving up a wall and hitting the ball when it is on or near the wall.
skills.whyItMatters: Balls often land in the corners and walls. Being able to play them keeps you in the play.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Wall Reads I.
instructions: Drive at the wall at an angle and keep [Gas] held so you stick to it.
Turn along the wall toward the ball, then hit it with the front of your car.
Jump ([Jump]) off the wall if you need to reach a ball in the air.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive up each side wall and back down without stopping.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Drive up a wall to hit a ball rolling along it.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit a ball off the wall 8 out of 10 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Drive up a wall and hit a ball rolling on it.
Come back down and keep driving smoothly.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Make at least two clean touches from the wall in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Practice driving up and down the wall with no ball first.

skills.name: Basic Challenges
skills.description: Going to the ball when an opponent has it, to take it away or make them play badly.
skills.whyItMatters: Challenging at the right moment wins possession and stops shots.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Basic 50/50s, Shadow Defense, Challenge Timing.
instructions: Drive at the ball with speed and aim to arrive at the same time as the opponent.
Use ball cam ([Ball Cam]) to watch both the ball and your opponent.
Do not challenge if a teammate is already going, or if you are far behind.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In a 1v1 against a bot, challenge the ball 10 times and note who wins.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Challenge from different starting distances and angles.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Win at least 5 of 10 challenges against a bot.

masteryRequirements.text: Win about half of your challenges against a bot.
Recover position after a lost challenge.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Challenge in a match only when you can arrive at the ball on time.

commonMistakes: Challenging when a teammate already has it.
skills.easierDrill: Challenge a slow bot from the front and only try to touch the ball first.

skills.name: Boost Management I
skills.description: Keeping boost available by grabbing pads on your route and not running empty.
skills.whyItMatters: Having boost when you need it turns plays into goals and saves.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Shadow Defense, Rotation Basics, Boost Management II.
instructions: Pick up small pads on your way instead of taking a long detour.
Take a big pad when you are already going that way and it is safe.
Do not boost when you are already at top speed.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive from goal to goal and pick up as many pads as possible without turning.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Play a 1v1 and check your boost every time you reset.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Play a match without dropping under 20 boost at any challenge.

masteryRequirements.text: Stay above 30 boost most of the time in a match.
Name where the closest big pad is from any spot.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Enter most challenges with boost in hand.

commonMistakes: Waiting to collect boost until empty.
skills.easierDrill: Play at half speed and collect every small pad along your route.

skills.name: Recovering from Upside Down
skills.description: Turning your car back to wheels-down when it is upside down or sideways in the air or on a wall.
skills.whyItMatters: Being upside down wastes seconds. A quick recovery keeps you in the play.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Faster Recoveries.
instructions: Tap [Air Roll Left] or [Air Roll Right] to roll toward the ground.
Combine with a little Left Stick tilt to line your wheels up with the ground or wall.
Touch down and keep driving with [Gas] to avoid losing speed.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, flip upside down on purpose and roll back to wheels 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Jump off a wall and recover to wheels before landing.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Recover from upside down 8 out of 10 times before touching the ground.

masteryRequirements.text: Recover from upside down before landing 8 out of 10 times.
Recover after a wall jump.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Land on your wheels after every aerial in a match.

commonMistakes: Waiting until the last moment to roll.
skills.easierDrill: Do slow recoveries from a low jump before trying higher ones.

skills.name: Powerslide Turnarounds
skills.description: Using [Powerslide] to turn around quickly and drive back the other way with speed.
skills.whyItMatters: Fast turnarounds get you back to defense or into the next attack.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Powerslide Cuts.
instructions: Start turning and hold [Powerslide] while steering into the turn.
Boost with [Boost] as you come out of the turn to regain speed.
Release [Powerslide] when your nose points where you want to go.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive forward and turn 180 degrees with [Powerslide].

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Turn around at speed and boost out of it.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Do 10 turnarounds in a row without stopping.

masteryRequirements.text: Turn around without losing most of your speed.
Do it to both sides.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Use a turnaround to get back to defense after a missed shot.

skills.easierDrill: Turn at low speed first and use wider turns.

skills.name: Basic 50/50s
skills.description: Winning a contest where you and an opponent reach the ball at the same time.
skills.whyItMatters: 50/50s decide who gets the next ball. Winning them creates chances.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Better 50/50 Control.
instructions: Approach the ball with speed and stay lined up on it.
Flip into the ball ([Jump] with the Left Stick forward) just before contact to add power.
Recover quickly after the hit so you are not out of position.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, hit a stationary ball with a flip 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Hit a ball rolling toward you with a flip.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Win 5 of 10 50/50s against a bot.

masteryRequirements.text: Win about half of 50/50s against a bot.
Recover after the hit within two seconds.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Take a 50/50 only when you have the boost and the angle.

commonMistakes: Both players going and nobody covering.
skills.easierDrill: Take 50/50s slowly at half speed until you time the flip.

skills.name: Ball Control Basics
skills.description: Keeping the ball close and under control by touching it lightly instead of hitting it away.
skills.whyItMatters: Control lets you choose what happens next: pass, shoot or keep possession.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Catching, Possession Basics.
instructions: Slow down as you reach the ball and touch it gently with the front of your car.
Use small tap touches with [Gas] and [Brake] to keep the ball rolling in front of you.
Use [Powerslide] to turn while keeping the ball near.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, push a rolling ball forward with light touches for 10 seconds.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Steer a rolling ball around the field without letting it get away.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Keep control of the ball for 20 seconds, 3 times in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Keep a ball rolling in front of you for 15 seconds.
Turn with the ball without losing it.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Keep possession for a few seconds after a touch instead of just hitting it away.

commonMistakes: Hitting the ball hard every time.
skills.easierDrill: Use very slow ball speeds and push it straight ahead first.

skills.name: Catching
skills.description: Absorbing a falling or bouncing ball onto your car so it sits still, ready for a dribble.
skills.whyItMatters: A caught ball gives you time to look up and choose. It is the first step to dribbling and flicks.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Bounce Dribbling, Air Dribble Fundamentals.
instructions: Drive under the ball and match its speed as it lands on your hood.
Ease off [Gas] and tap [Brake] to keep it still instead of bouncing away.
Steer gently to keep the ball centered on your car.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drop the ball in front of you and let it land on your hood, 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Catch a ball thrown from the side while driving.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Catch 5 balls in a row and hold each for 2 seconds.

masteryRequirements.text: Catch a ball dropped from mid-air 8 out of 10 times.
Hold it steady for 3 seconds.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Catch a bouncing ball in a match to start an attack instead of just hitting it away.

commonMistakes: Going too fast at the ball.
skills.easierDrill: Practice with a ball that is already rolling slowly on the ground.

skills.name: Bounce Dribbling
skills.description: Controlling a bouncing ball by touching it lightly so it stays near your car.
skills.whyItMatters: It lets you carry the ball toward the goal and set up flicks and shots.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Flick Fundamentals.
instructions: Catch the ball, then give it small taps with your hood to keep it bouncing near you.
Match your speed to the ball with [Gas] and [Brake].
Steer with small movements to keep it above you.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, bounce the ball off your car 5 times without losing it.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Drive across the field bounce dribbling.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Bounce dribble for 10 seconds without losing the ball, 3 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Bounce dribble the length of the field.
Keep control while turning.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Carry the ball a few seconds in a match before passing or shooting.

skills.easierDrill: Do two bounces at a time, then extend.

skills.name: Flick Fundamentals
skills.description: Popping the ball off your car with a flip to shoot it at the net with power.
skills.whyItMatters: A flick creates goals from a controlled possession. It also makes you dangerous in 1v1.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Consistent Flicks.
instructions: Carry the ball and drive toward the goal with it centered on your hood.
Jump ([Jump]) and flip into the ball with the Left Stick pushed in the direction you want it to go.
Time the flip as the ball begins to roll toward the top of your car.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, catch the ball and do a forward flick at an open net 10 times.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Dribble from midfield and flick at the goal.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Score 5 flicks in a row from dribbling.

masteryRequirements.text: Score a flick on an open net 7 out of 10 times.
Flick to both sides.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Start a flick attempt in a match only when you have a clear dribble.

skills.easierDrill: Practice the flick from a stationary ball on the ground.

skills.name: Powerslide Cuts
skills.description: Using [Powerslide] to change direction sharply while keeping your speed.
skills.whyItMatters: Cuts let you redirect toward the ball or a boost pad without slowing down.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Shooting, Faster Recoveries, Kickoff Variations.
instructions: Tap [Powerslide] while steering toward the new direction.
Release it as the car points where you want and hit [Boost] to keep speed.
Use small taps rather than long slides.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, drive straight, then cut 45 degrees with a short [Powerslide].

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Cut toward a rolling ball from different angles.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Do 10 cuts in a row with no loss of speed.

masteryRequirements.text: Cut toward the ball without stopping.
Do cuts to the left and to the right.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Use a cut to reach the ball on a bounce instead of driving past it.

skills.easierDrill: Make wider cuts at lower speed.

skills.name: Shadow Defense
skills.description: Backing up in front of the attacker, staying between them and your goal without committing to the ball.
skills.whyItMatters: Shadowing forces a bad shot or a bad pass instead of giving up an easy goal.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Fake Challenges, Shadow Defense Consistency, Challenge Timing.
instructions: Face the attacker with ball cam ([Ball Cam]) on and drive backward toward your goal at their speed.
Keep about a car length or two of space between you and them.
Only go for the ball when they make a mistake or the ball is loose.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, have the ball dribbled toward you and back up while facing it.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Shadow a bot as it dribbles from midfield to the goal.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Shadow 5 attacks in a row without diving in.

masteryRequirements.text: Keep space between you and a dribbling bot for 5 seconds.
Save a shot taken from the side.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Defend several attacks in a match without diving in early.

commonMistakes: Getting too close to the attacker.
skills.easierDrill: Shadow a slow bot at half speed.

skills.name: Defensive Positioning
skills.description: Choosing where to stand in defense so you cover the shot and the pass.
skills.whyItMatters: Good angles cut off shots and give you time to challenge.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Rotation Basics, Defensive Aerials, Possession Basics, Back-Post Rotation and 1 more.
instructions: Stand on the line between the ball and the center of your goal.
Move as the ball moves so you stay on that line.
Stay a little back from the ball so you have time to react.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, move the ball around your box and stay between it and the net.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: React to shots from the left and right.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Cover 5 different shot angles without conceding.

masteryRequirements.text: Stay on the ball-to-goal line for 10 seconds.
Cover far-post and near-post shots.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Find yourself in a good defensive position before most opponent shots.

skills.easierDrill: Stand still in the goal and only cover one side at a time.

skills.name: Wall Reads I
skills.description: Predicting where the ball will bounce off a wall so you are ready for it.
skills.whyItMatters: You get there first and hit it cleanly instead of scrambling.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Wall Reads II.
instructions: Watch the ball hit the wall and think about the angle it comes back at.
Drive to the spot where it will land, not where it is now.
Use ball cam ([Ball Cam]) to see the bounce.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, hit the ball at the side wall and get to where it lands.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do it at different speeds and angles.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Meet the ball off the wall 8 out of 10 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Meet a wall bounce 8 out of 10 times.
Predict a bounce off a back wall.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Read at least two wall bounces in a match and arrive first.

commonMistakes: Chasing the ball instead of predicting.
skills.easierDrill: Do slow, gentle wall bounces first.

skills.name: Kickoff Fundamentals
skills.description: Driving to the ball at the start of a round and winning or safely contesting the first touch.
skills.whyItMatters: Kickoffs happen every time a goal is scored. A good one gives your team an early advantage.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Kickoff Variations.
instructions: Boost ([Boost]) from the start and drive straight at the ball.
Flip ([Jump] with the stick forward) just before contact.
In team modes, the closest player goes for the ball and others take boost.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, practice your kickoff from each spawn position.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do 10 kickoffs from the diagonal spawn.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit the ball on 8 of 10 kickoffs.

masteryRequirements.text: Hit the ball on 8 out of 10 kickoffs.
Take boost as you drive if you are not going for the ball.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Play kickoffs in a match with a plan for each spawn.

commonMistakes: Two teammates both going for the ball.
skills.easierDrill: Practice from the closest spawn only.

skills.name: Rotation Basics
skills.description: Taking turns with your teammate: one attacks, the other supports, then you swap.
skills.whyItMatters: Rotation keeps someone back and stops you both chasing the same ball.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Back-Post Rotation, Third-Man Positioning and Spacing.
instructions: After you touch the ball, drive back toward your goal along the edge of the field.
Pick up boost on the way and get ready to support.
Let your teammate take the next ball if they are closer.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In a 2v2, rotate back after every touch for 5 minutes.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Rotate through the boost pads on the way back.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Play a full match without both of you going for the ball.

masteryRequirements.text: Rotate back after each touch in a match.
Never double-commit with a teammate.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Notice that a teammate had the ball three times and you supported.

skills.easierDrill: Rotate back after every touch, even if it feels slow.

skills.name: Consistent Flicks
skills.description: Doing flicks reliably and in more than one direction, from real dribbles.
skills.whyItMatters: A flick you can rely on turns possessions into goals, especially in 1v1.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Flicks.
instructions: Dribble with the ball centered and slightly forward on your hood.
Flip ([Jump]) toward the goal or a corner with the stick angled to aim.
Follow up with [Boost] to keep pressure.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, do 10 flicks to the left and 10 to the right.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Dribble from midfield and flick at goal.

drills.title: Pressure
drills.text: Play a 1v1 and flick when you have the ball.

masteryRequirements.text: Flick on target 7 out of 10 times.
Flick to both sides.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Hit at least one flick in a match that forces a save.

commonMistakes: Flicking before the ball is set.
skills.easierDrill: Go back to a stationary ball and repeat.

skills.name: Advanced Shooting
skills.description: Shooting with power and placement from awkward angles, including off the wall and in the air.
skills.whyItMatters: Better shots score even when the goalkeeper is set.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Precision Finishing.
instructions: Line up your shot early using ball cam ([Ball Cam]).
Choose between power and placement based on where the keeper is.
Use a flip ([Jump]) through the ball for extra speed.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, shoot from tight angles and corners.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Hit the ball in the air and off the wall toward the goal.

drills.title: Pressure
drills.text: Take a shot against a bot goalkeeper.

masteryRequirements.text: Score from a tight angle 6 out of 10 times.
Choose power or placement when asked.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Score in a match with a shot you lined up early.

skills.easierDrill: Start with an empty net from a tight angle.

statChecks.label: Score on at least 35% of your shots over 5 matches

skills.name: Defensive Aerials
skills.description: Going into the air to stop a shot or clear a ball that is coming down toward your goal.
skills.whyItMatters: Many shots are in the air. You need to save them there.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Backboard Defense.
instructions: Read the shot early and jump ([Jump]) toward it.
Boost ([Boost]) and tilt up to reach the ball.
Hit it away from the goal and recover quickly.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, have the ball shot in the air toward your goal and hit it away.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Hit balls coming from the wall.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Clear 7 of 10 aerial shots.

masteryRequirements.text: Clear a high shot 7 out of 10 times.
Land on your wheels afterward.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Stop a shot in the air in a match.

commonMistakes: Missing and leaving the goal open.
skills.easierDrill: Practice from a ball that is close to the crossbar.

skills.name: Better 50/50 Control
skills.description: Winning the ball in a contest and steering it toward where you want it to go.
skills.whyItMatters: A controlled 50/50 keeps possession or sends the ball into space.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: 50/50 Techniques.
instructions: Approach the ball at an angle that lets you steer it.
Flip through the ball with the stick angled toward where you want it to go.
Move off the ball to cover the next touch.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, hit a rolling ball with a flip and send it to a target.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Contest a ball against a bot and aim for the side.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Win 6 of 10 50/50s against a bot.

masteryRequirements.text: Win 6 out of 10 50/50s against a bot.
Direct the ball to a chosen side.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Win a 50/50 in a match and follow it up.

commonMistakes: Only trying to win the ball, not steer it.
skills.easierDrill: Use a slower ball first.

skills.name: Fake Challenges
skills.description: Pretending to challenge so the attacker mishandles the ball, then backing off.
skills.whyItMatters: Fakes force errors without risking a lost challenge.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Shadow Defense, Advanced Challenges.
instructions: Approach the attacker as if to challenge.
Slow down or stop with [Brake] at the last moment.
Move in for the ball when they misplay.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, approach the ball and fake a challenge before backing off.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Fake against a bot dribbler.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Force a mistake 3 out of 5 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Force a bad touch from a bot 3 out of 5 times.
Recover after the fake.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Make an attacker misplay because of a fake.

commonMistakes: Fake too early or too late.
skills.easierDrill: Practice slower with a bot that moves slowly.

skills.name: Shadow Defense Consistency
skills.description: Keeping shadow defense steady against different types of attacks, including flick attempts.
skills.whyItMatters: Consistent shadowing shuts down most attackers.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Shadow Defense.
instructions: Keep facing the ball with ball cam ([Ball Cam]).
Adjust your distance for the attacker's speed.
Prepare for a flick by staying back and ready to jump ([Jump]).

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, shadow a dribbling bot to the goal.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Shadow from different starting positions.

drills.title: Pressure
drills.text: Defend 5 attacks in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Defend 5 attacks in a row without diving in.
Save a flick attempt.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Defend multiple different attacks in a match.

commonMistakes: Freezing when the attacker changes direction.
skills.easierDrill: Slow the attack down by picking a slower bot.

skills.name: Wall Reads II
skills.description: Using what you know about wall bounces to intercept balls and pre-position.
skills.whyItMatters: It lets you win balls that others miss.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Wall Play, Backboard Defense, Double Taps, Advanced Wall Reads.
instructions: Predict the bounce and move to the spot early.
Prepare to hit the ball as it comes off the wall.
Use boost ([Boost]) to reach the ball on time.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, hit the ball high on the wall and meet it.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do it at different speeds.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Meet 8 of 10 wall bounces.

masteryRequirements.text: Meet a wall bounce cleanly 8 out of 10 times.
Pre-position before the bounce.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Win balls off the wall in a match.

skills.name: Boost Management II
skills.description: Planning your boost so you have some for the important moments and can deny some from the opponent.
skills.whyItMatters: Boost control wins games in the long run.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Speed Management, Boost Starvation.
instructions: Plan your path across the pads before going for the ball.
Keep a reserve for defense.
Take the far big pad if you are safe.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, plan a route through 4 pads.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Play a 1v1 and track your boost.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Never drop below 20 boost during a full match.

masteryRequirements.text: Stay above 25 boost most of the match.
Take big pads on your way back.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Have boost available at each challenge.

skills.easierDrill: Practice only planning your route through pads.

skills.name: Faster Recoveries
skills.description: Recovering quickly and landing already moving toward the play.
skills.whyItMatters: A fast recovery gets you back into the game before the opponent.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Recoveries.
instructions: Air roll ([Air Roll Left] or [Air Roll Right]) early so you land on your wheels.
Land with [Powerslide] held to point the car where you want to go.
Boost ([Boost]) out of the landing to regain speed.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, jump off a wall and land with a powerslide.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Recover after an aerial and drive to a pad.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Recover into a drive 8 out of 10 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Land and be moving toward the play within a second.
Recover after an aerial.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Get back to the play quickly after an aerial.

skills.easierDrill: Do the recovery without boost first.

skills.name: Challenge Timing
skills.description: Deciding when to go for the ball and when to hold back.
skills.whyItMatters: Good timing wins the ball without leaving your net open.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Last-Man Discipline, Advanced Challenges.
instructions: Go for the ball when you can arrive first or at the same time as the opponent.
Wait when a teammate is closer or you are far behind.
Use [Brake] to slow down if it is not the right time.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: Play a 1v1 against a bot and only challenge when you are close.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Practice challenging at different distances.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Only take good challenges for a full match.

masteryRequirements.text: Take only good challenges for one full match.
Recover after a lost challenge.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Skip at least three bad challenges in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Only challenge when the ball is close to you.

skills.name: Possession Basics
skills.description: Making touches that keep the ball on your side and avoiding giving it away.
skills.whyItMatters: More possession means more chances and fewer shots against.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: High-Speed Decision Making.
instructions: Prefer safe touches that stay in your control.
Use dribbling or passing instead of hitting blindly.
Clear to the side if you are under pressure.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, keep the ball for 15 seconds.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Keep it while moving up the field.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Keep it 3 times in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Keep possession for 15 seconds.
Clear to a safe area when under pressure.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Have fewer giveaways in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Practice only keeping the ball in front of you.

skills.name: Back-Post Rotation
skills.description: Rotating back through the far side of your goal so you can cover the far post.
skills.whyItMatters: It covers the most dangerous shot lane.
skills.whatItUnlocks: This is a top-level habit: it keeps everything you already know working at game speed.
instructions: After attacking, drive back around the outside and reach the far post.
Pick up boost as you go.
Be ready to save or clear.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In a 2v2, rotate to the back post after each attack.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Rotate and pick up boost on the way.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Do it after every touch for a full match.

masteryRequirements.text: Reach the far post after each attack.
Cover the far post 3 times in a match.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Rotate to the back post after each attack.

skills.easierDrill: Practice the route without the ball.

skills.name: Last-Man Discipline
skills.description: Staying back as the last defender and not going for risky challenges.
skills.whyItMatters: The last man protects the goal. If you fail, the other team has an open net.
skills.whatItUnlocks: This is a top-level habit: it keeps everything you already know working at game speed.
instructions: Stay between the ball and your goal.
Only challenge if it is safe.
Use ball cam ([Ball Cam]) to keep the ball in view while you hold position.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In a 2v2, play as the last man for 3 minutes.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Delay attackers while a teammate recovers.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Complete a match without being the cause of a goal.

masteryRequirements.text: Stay back for a full match.
Delay an attack until a teammate arrives.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Delay attackers as the last man.

skills.easierDrill: Practice only delaying, not challenging.

skills.name: Third-Man Positioning and Spacing
skills.description: Positioning as the third player so you support the play and cover the back.
skills.whyItMatters: It keeps your team balanced.
skills.whatItUnlocks: This is a top-level habit: it keeps everything you already know working at game speed.
instructions: Stay behind the ball and your teammates.
Keep space between you and them.
Move up as the play moves up.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In a 3v3, play as the third man for 3 minutes.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Keep space while the play moves.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Support without ball chasing for a full match.

masteryRequirements.text: Keep proper spacing for a full match.
Cover the back when a teammate goes.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Be in position to support or defend.

skills.easierDrill: Stay behind the ball as it moves.

skills.name: Fast Aerials
skills.description: Leaving the ground with a jump, a quick tilt and a second jump so you reach the ball sooner.
skills.whyItMatters: Getting up faster lets you beat opponents to airborne balls.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Air Roll Aerial Control, Double Taps.
instructions: Press [Jump], then right away pull the Left Stick back and hold [Boost].
Press [Jump] a second time while boosting. Keep the stick near neutral so you do not flip backward.
Steer toward the ball with the Left Stick and use [Air Roll Left] or [Air Roll Right] to line up.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, do 10 fast aerials straight up without a target.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Hit a ball dropped at head height with a fast aerial.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit 8 of 10 high balls with a fast aerial.

masteryRequirements.text: Reach a high ball 8 out of 10 times with a fast aerial.
Land on your wheels afterward.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Beat an opponent to an air ball using a fast aerial.

commonMistakes: Flipping backward on the second jump.
Not boosting at the right time.
skills.easierDrill: Do a normal aerial with just a small second jump.

skills.name: Air Roll Aerial Control
skills.description: Using air roll to steer and line your car up in the air.
skills.whyItMatters: Control in the air lets you hit the ball at the angle you want.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Air Dribble Fundamentals, Advanced Aerial Control, Ceiling Play.
instructions: Hold [Air Roll Left] or [Air Roll Right] while turning to rotate your car.
Use the Left Stick to adjust pitch and yaw as you air roll.
Line up the front of your car with the ball before contact.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, jump and boost while rolling your car in the air.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Line up with a ball dropped from above.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit 8 of 10 balls with a controlled air roll.

masteryRequirements.text: Control the direction of your car in the air 8 out of 10 times.
Hit the ball with the nose pointing where you aim.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Use air roll to line up an aerial hit in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Practice air roll without a ball first.

skills.name: Advanced Wall Play
skills.description: Playing the ball off the wall into the air, and carrying it up the wall.
skills.whyItMatters: It opens up new angles and keeps possession.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Wall Reads, Ceiling Play.
instructions: Drive up the wall and jump ([Jump]) off it toward the ball.
Use boost ([Boost]) and air roll to line up.
Land smoothly and keep moving.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, jump off the wall and hit the ball in the air.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Carry the ball up the wall.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Hit the ball off the wall 8 of 10 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Hit the ball off a wall jump 8 out of 10 times.
Carry the ball up a wall.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Play the ball off the wall in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Practice only the wall jump with no ball.

skills.name: Backboard Defense
skills.description: Stopping or clearing balls that come off your own backboard toward your net.
skills.whyItMatters: Backboard shots are common and dangerous.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Backboard Clears.
instructions: Watch the ball come off the backboard and move to where it will drop.
Jump ([Jump]) and boost ([Boost]) to hit it away.
Clear to the side.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, hit the ball off your backboard and clear the rebound.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Save a shot off the backboard.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Clear 7 of 10 backboard shots.

masteryRequirements.text: Clear 7 out of 10 backboard shots.
Get out of the goal quickly after.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Clear a backboard shot in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Start with slow backboard rebounds.

skills.name: Air Dribble Fundamentals
skills.description: Keeping the ball close to your car in the air with small touches while boosting.
skills.whyItMatters: It lets you carry the ball over defenders and set up shots.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Consistent Air Dribbles.
instructions: Start with a ball rolling up the wall or bouncing near you.
Jump ([Jump]) and boost ([Boost]) up to the ball, tapping it gently.
Steer with the Left Stick and air roll to stay under the ball.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, pop the ball up and follow it in the air for 2 touches.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do a short air dribble from the wall.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Get 3 touches in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Complete a 3 touch air dribble.
Do it twice in a row.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Try an air dribble only when there is space and you have boost.

skills.easierDrill: Practice with a ball already in the air.

skills.name: Advanced Recoveries
skills.description: Recovering into a fast move such as a wave dash or a recovery flip to keep or gain speed.
skills.whyItMatters: Speed after landing beats opponents to the next ball.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Recovery Efficiency.
instructions: As you land, flip ([Jump] with the stick pointing along your direction) just before touching the ground.
Keep [Powerslide] ready to control the landing.
Boost ([Boost]) after landing.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, do 10 landings with a flip at the last moment.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do it while returning to goal.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Land with speed 7 of 10 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Land with speed 7 out of 10 times.
Use it after an aerial.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Return to defense quickly after an aerial.

skills.easierDrill: Practice the landing flip at low speed.

skills.name: 50/50 Techniques
skills.description: Using delayed flips, angled blocks and fakes to win contested balls.
skills.whyItMatters: More options make you harder to read.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced 50/50s.
instructions: Time the flip slightly later for extra power.
Angle your car to block the ball to a side.
Sometimes hold back and let the opponent commit.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, practice a delayed flip on a rolling ball.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Practice an angled block.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Win 6 of 10 against a bot.

masteryRequirements.text: Win 6 out of 10 50/50s using the new options.
Use at least two techniques.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Win a 50/50 using a technique.

skills.name: Speed Management
skills.description: Knowing when to be fast and when to slow down so you arrive in control.
skills.whyItMatters: Too much speed makes you miss. Too little gets you beaten.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Boost Starvation, Speed Control.
instructions: Boost ([Boost]) to reach top speed on open ground.
Ease off ([Brake] or release [Gas]) before a challenge.
Use small pads to keep going without wasting boost.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, reach the ball at full speed and at half speed.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Match your speed to the ball.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Arrive in control 8 of 10 times.

masteryRequirements.text: Arrive at the ball in control 8 out of 10 times.
Slow down at the right time.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Arrive at the ball at the right speed.

skills.name: Consistent Air Dribbles
skills.description: Air dribbling reliably, including toward the goal.
skills.whyItMatters: A consistent air dribble creates goals and pressure.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Advanced Air Dribbles.
instructions: Start from a controlled ball and jump ([Jump]) up with it.
Tap the ball with small touches, boosting ([Boost]) as needed.
Finish with a hit at the goal.

drills.title: Basic
drills.text: In Freeplay, do a 5 touch air dribble.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do it toward the goal.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Finish 5 in a row.

masteryRequirements.text: Finish 5 air dribbles in a row.
Do them from both sides.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Complete an air dribble in a match.

skills.easierDrill: Keep to 3 touches.

skills.description: Hitting the ball in the air off the backboard for a second touch on goal.
skills.whyItMatters: It scores from shots that would otherwise be saved.
skills.whatItUnlocks: Leads to: Double Taps Under Pressure.

Follow it with boost ([Boost]) and air roll.
Hit it again as it comes off the backboard.

drills.text: In Freeplay, hit the ball off the backboard and follow it.

drills.text: Do a full double tap.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Score 5 of 10.

Do it from either side.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Try a double tap when the ball is high and you have boost.

skills.description: Reading fast bounces off walls and corners, and using them to gain an advantage.
skills.whyItMatters: It lets you get to the ball first.
skills.whatItUnlocks: This is a top-level habit: it keeps everything you already know working at game speed.
instructions: Predict bounces at high speed.
Move early to the meeting point.
Take the ball with speed.

drills.text: In Freeplay, hit fast balls at the corner and meet the bounce.

drills.title: Movement
drills.text: Do it from different angles.

drills.title: Consistency
drills.text: Meet 8 of 10 balls.

masteryRequirements.text: Meet 8 out of 10 fast bounces.
Predict a corner bounce.

matchApplicationRequirements.text: Get to a corner bounce first.
